notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl, Chrome UA impersonation) worked for every page fetched - robots.txt has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow (only standard SFCC account/cart/checkout/search/api paths blocked, none relevant here); homepage, sitemap_1-category.xml (508 URLs), and ~50 individual category pages all returned full server-rendered HTML (200-600KB) including product grids, product-tile elements, and a result-count element with data-products-count attribute. No Playwright/CDP escalation needed. TREE: union of homepage mega-menu hrefs + sitemap_1-category.xml + each parent category page's own in-page sub-nav (all three sources cross-checked and consistent). Site is Demandware/SFCC (on/demandware.store). This is a home-decor/tableware retailer (Textiles de bano, Textil de cocina, Manteleria de mesa, Textil de salon, Telas de exterior for textile; Almacenaje, Organizadores de cocina, Tapers-botes-y-contenedores, Organizadores de bano for storage) - no dedicated bedroom/bedding department found (checked sitemap for sabana/edredon/funda/almohada/colcha/dormitorio keywords - only Christmas-seasonal 'funda-cojin-navidad' exists, excluded as seasonal). Excluded the entire /navidad/ (Christmas) textile subtree as a seasonal microsite absent from the main mega-menu, plus all /rebajas/* (sales) and *-black-friday (promo) duplicate URLs per the View-All/Collection/promotional exclusion rule. QTY: read from the rendered listing page's data-products-count attribute / 'N Resultados' header text; cross-validated by summing children against each parent's own total (bano/textil-de-bano 3+0+15=18=parent; cocina/textil-de-cocina 0+5+1=6=parent; comedor/manteleria 1+3(excl)+7+14+8=33=parent; salon/textil-de-salon 6+23+3+7=39=parent; cocina/organizadores 0+3+2(excl)+4(excl)+1=10=parent; orden-del-hogar/almacenaje 1+5+1+0+4=11=parent) - all matched exactly, confirming the extraction method is accurate on this site. Several categories rendered a genuinely empty product-tile grid (0 items, no result-count text) despite correct h1/canonical - recorded as qty=0 rather than null since the empty-grid fact is directly observed, not estimated. EXCLUDED (checked, not textile/storage): comedor/manteleria/complementos ('Servilleteros, posavasos y salvamanteles' = napkin rings/coasters/trivets, non-textile hard materials); cocina/organizadores/dispensadores ('Dispensador de jabon para cocina' = kitchen soap dispenser, not storage); cocina/organizadores/escurreplatos (dish drainers/drying racks, a kitchen drying tool not storage/organization); cocina/tapers-botes-y-contenedores/fiambreras-infantiles (children's lunch boxes, personal-carry not home storage, same reasoning as orden-del-hogar/accesorios-de-viaje lunch bags and orden-del-hogar/carros-y-bolsas-de-compra shopping trolleys, both excluded); orden-del-hogar/papeleras-y-recicladores (waste/recycling bins, not storage of belongings); orden-del-hogar/limpieza (cleaning tools); bano/complementos-de-bano/{dosificadores-y-jaboneros,escobilleros,portacepillos,basculas,cubos-de-bano,espejos} (bathroom fixtures/accessories, not storage); Tarros and Cajas de cocina exist only as in-page refinement filters (Search-ShowAjax?cgid=) with no standalone canonical URL - excluded per no-search-URL rule, only their sibling facets Tapers and Conservadores that DO have dedicated canonical pages were recorded. All Furniture/Lighting/Kitchen&Dining/Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories nodes (muebles/*, iluminacion/*, comedor/vajillas,cristaleria,cubiertos,cafe-y-te, salon/decoracion-salon,jarrones-y-flores,velas-e-inciensos, cocina/utensilios,ollas-y-sartenes,pequenos-electrodomesticos,reposteria,cocinas-del-mundo,picnic,cafeteras-y-teteras, terraza-y-jardin/muebles-de-jardin-y-exterior,barbacoas,decoracion-de-jardin,parasoles-y-cenadores) were seen and skipped as out of scope for this task.
